fields.description: When off, /desk is unchanged and /remix redirects there. Enable Remix, then turn on History, Favorites, and/or Alternative Navigation.
fields.label: Enable Remix

fields.description: Clock menu in the regular Frappe navbar with the last 10 distinct pages from Route History.
fields.label: History

fields.description: Bookmark star in the regular Frappe navbar: save the current page (lists, reports, documents) and open it later from the dropdown. If Alternative Navigation is also on, apps can be starred in the switcher.
fields.label: Favorites

fields.description: Replace the Frappe sidebar with the Remix app switcher and menu. The Frappe sidebar stays when this is off.
fields.label: Alternative Navigation

fields.description: Awesome Bar search at the top of the Remix sidebar, above the app switcher.
fields.label: Search

fields.description: Let each user pick a Desk Colour theme for the Desk background and the Remix sidebar (same themes as Desk Background). Until a theme is chosen, chrome follows the system Desk colours.
fields.label: Colors

fields.description: Also allow hex colours (Background, Sidebar) instead of a Desk Colour theme.
fields.label: Manual Colours
